needed_streams: Zone-level load indicators and contextual HVAC streams to disambiguate local load change from sensor fault: (1) Zone_F3_Z01 electrical power / end-use load (or IT equipment load), (2) outdoor air temperature, (3) Zone_F3_Z01 and AHU duct supply/return air temperatures and fan/cooling valve actuation, (4) occupancy schedule or CO2 for that zone, and (5) a redundant/secondary temperature sensor in Zone_F3_Z01 for cross-check. The current catalog only exposes Zone air temperature sensors and thermal setpoints, which rise together (sensor mean offset to cooling setpoint goes from −2.1 °C before July 2018 to −0.13 °C after, with 2417 of 4417 after-hours reading exactly the cooling setpoint) — a pattern fully consistent with both a genuine local heat-load increase pushing the zone to its setpoint AND a sensor that has started echoing the setpoint, so they cannot be told apart with temperature + setpoint streams alone.

input.needed_streams: Zone-level load indicators and contextual HVAC streams to disambiguate local load change from sensor fault: (1) Zone_F3_Z01 electrical power / end-use load (or IT equipment load), (2) outdoor air temperature, (3) Zone_F3_Z01 and AHU duct supply/return air temperatures and fan/cooling valve actuation, (4) occupancy schedule or CO2 for that zone, and (5) a redundant/secondary temperature sensor in Zone_F3_Z01 for cross-check. The current catalog only exposes Zone air temperature sensors and thermal setpoints, which rise together (sensor mean offset to cooling setpoint goes from −2.1 °C before July 2018 to −0.13 °C after, with 2417 of 4417 after-hours reading exactly the cooling setpoint) — a pattern fully consistent with both a genuine local heat-load increase pushing the zone to its setpoint AND a sensor that has started echoing the setpoint, so they cannot be told apart with temperature + setpoint streams alone.
